titleEnglish: Sirtaaj-e-Peeran Kutb-e-Jahani — Hazrat Syed Bedam Shah Warsi

verses.en:
The crown of the spiritual masters, the spiritual pivot of the world,
Meera Mohiyuddin, the Sheikh of the entire world.

verses.ar:
Khijr-e-tariqat shamme hidayat
Bahr-e-haqiqat ganj-e-ma aani
verses.en:
The Khidr (guide) of the spiritual path, the lamp of divine guidance,
An ocean of ultimate truth, a treasure-trove of profound meanings.

verses.ar:
Jaan-e-payambar jaanan-e-shabbar
Haidar ke dilbar Zahra ke jaani
verses.en:
Beloved of the Prophet, the beloved of Imam Shabbar (Hasan),
The darling of Haidar (Ali), the cherished one of Zahra (Fatima).

verses.ar:
Haatho ke qurba ukda kushayi
Sadke labo par mauzij bayani
verses.en:
May I be sacrificed for those hands that unravel every difficulty,
And for those lips from which eloquence flows like a surging tide.

verses.ar:
Judo sakha mai lutf-o-ataa mai
Hamsar tumhara koi na saani
verses.en:
In generosity and benevolence, in kindness and bestowal,
You have no equal, no peer.

verses.ar:
Aye kaash sunte sarkar-e-jila
Meri kahani meri zubani
verses.en:
Oh, if only the Master of Jilan (Baghdad) would hear,
My story, in my own words.

verses.ar:
Aye rashk-e-isa bedum hai bedum
Kijiye ilaaj-e-dard-e-nihani
verses.en:
O you who make Jesus envious, I am left utterly helpless,
Please, provide a cure for this hidden pain within my heart.
